explanation: A is correct because relationships are one of the core building blocks of a data model and are used to represent how entities are connected. Attributes describe properties of an entity, identifiers distinguish entity instances, and calculations are not the main purpose of a relationship in a conceptual model.

options.text: To show how instances of Customer and Order are associated with each other
To list every attribute that belongs to both entities
To replace the identifier of each entity with a shared code
To calculate values that are missing from one of the entities

prompt: In a conceptual data model, what is the main role of a relationship between two entities such as Customer and Order?
